text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] Reserved pool eu-west-reserved-42 at 100% capacity. Autoscaler failed to add nodes. Affected tenants: BrightBank (enterprise-resv-12), DocuPortal (burst). Queue length rising. Pager: @oncall-raj

oncall-raj: on it. toggling into triage channel. initial ask: is this a scheduler/instance limit or hardware scarcity?

maya: seeing repeated errors from autoscaler: `QuotaExceeded` when requesting G4dn. stack trace attached.

incident-bot: ```
2026-03-15T09:22:41Z autoscaler ERROR request failed: AllocateInstances: QuotaExceeded: NotEnoughHosts
	status code: 400, request id: c3f2-...
2026-03-15T09:22:47Z autoscaler WARN backoff 30s
```

anthony: confirmed, cloud quota for G4/G5 family in eu-west is hitting account soft limits. also noisy tenants consuming reserved slots via overbooked reservations. BrightBank is pinned but DocuPortal has burst flags that weren't evicted.

oncall-raj: immediate mitigation plan: 1) shed best-effort burst tenants from reserved pool 2) open manual scale request to infra to add hosts (if quota can be bumped) 3) enable model fallback routing for BrightBank -> gpt-medium-ops so critical traffic stays live. I'll start 1 and 3 now.

maya: to evict burst tenants: running eviction script `tools/evict-burst --pool eu-west-reserved-42 --filter burst=true`

maya: ```
$ tools/evict-burst --pool eu-west-reserved-42 --filter burst=true --dry-run
matched: tenant-docuportal (burst)
matched: tenant-openlab (best-effort)
```

maya: executing now (non-dry-run). watchers: this will gracefully reject new allocations and drain running best-effort jobs over 30s.

cs-emily: I'm DMing BrightBank (AM: @derek-bb) to say we're working an incident and we'll failover some of their heavy endpoints to a backup model to preserve latency. Will ask for impacted endpoints.

anthony: attempting manual scale up via infra ticket: `INFRA-3421` opened requesting +4 G4 instances in eu-west, marked high priority. If quota bump approved, autoscaler will pick them up.

oncall-raj: enabling per-tenant throttling for non-critical endpoints on BrightBank to reduce token generation rate temporarily. Command: `rctl set-rate tenant=BrightBank endpoint=/generate rate=0.6`

maya: routing rule applied: BrightBank production -> fallback model `gpt-medium-ops` for endpoints `/generate` and `/sync`. This will reduce GPU utilization ~45%.

deploy-bot: :package: routing change deployed to route-service at 09:26Z (rev: 2026-03-15_926_fallback).

anthony: quick health checks: cluster CPU 90% on host nodes, GPU mem used 100% on reserved nodes. queue backlog for reserved pool: 420 requests (avg enqueue 8/s). After eviction, backlog dropped to 260.

oncall-raj: good. still seeing autoscaler failing with same quota error, but backlog stabilization trending down. continuing to monitor. tagging @sre-jen for handoff in 20m.

sre-jen: joining. quick summary for next-oncall: root cause looks like a combination of cloud family quota exhaustion + noisy-burst tenants occupying reserved slots due to reservation misattribution. mitigation executed: eviction of burst tenants, rollback of some burst reservations, enable fallback routing, throttle on BrightBank endpoints, infra ticket for manual scale.

cs-emily: BrightBank PM replied: they see increased 429s on one endpoint but report acceptable latency on fallback. asked for ETA. I told them we'll follow up when infra confirms scale or quota bump.

maya: note: autoscaler code has a tight retry loop causing aggressive requests on quota errors. filed bug: AUTOSCALE-998. short-term we increased backoff to 120s to avoid spamming cloud API.

anthony: infra: requested quota bump but cloud helpdesk says 2-3 hours for approval. we have one short-term option: enable spillover to hosted instances for enterprise reserved pools (policy toggle). that will route excess BrightBank traffic to our hosted managed capacity with token-level billing. need CS approval to enable.

cs-emily: approved to enable hosted spillover for BrightBank for up to 2 hours. do it.

maya: enabled hosted_spillover for tenant BrightBank at 09:34Z. immediate effect: backlog down to 85, errors reduced. GPU utilization on reserved pool now 80%.

oncall-raj: tracking timeline: 09:22 alert -> 09:28 eviction -> 09:34 hosted spillover -> 09:36 backlog control. handing off to @sre-jen for followup and RCA owner.

sre-jen: I'll own postmortem and coord with capacity planning. action items: 1) increase reserved pool allocation or add automatic spillover 2) fix autoscaler backoff logic 3) add tenant reservation audit to prevent misattribution 4) notify BrightBank account team and provide incident summary.

oncall-raj: adding tag incident: capacity/reservation/noisy-neighbor. leaving channel. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-jen: taking over. I'll schedule a quick sync with product/cs/infra at 11:00Z and start the RCA doc. Please paste any logs or small snippets here if you grabbed them during triage.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — backlog reduced below threshold and 429 rate for BrightBank reduced to <1%. Escalation notes: AUTOSCALE-998, INFRA-3421, AUTOSPILLOVER-2026 created.

cs-emily: I'll send customer note now and flag billing for hosted spillover during the window.

sre-jen: next steps: preserve logs, collect perf graphs, and draft postmortem. closing thread but will link RCA when ready.

oncall-raj: (added) please rotate reservation audit to weekly until we fix prevention.

maya: ack. pushing audit rule now.
